Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.query

Class LengthAwarePage

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.query.LengthAwarePage
public final class LengthAwarePage extends Object
One page of rows with the total number of matching rows, as PageQueries.paginate(int, int) returns it; Laravel's LengthAwarePaginator without the URL and HTML parts.

Immutable and safe to share between threads; the rows are unmodifiable.
